notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR4: "A description of a report group may consist of one, two, or three hierarchic levels": a. the first entry is format 1; b. "Both format 2 and format 3 entries may be immediately subordinate to a format 1 entry"; c. a format 2 entry has a format 3 entry immediately subordinate; d. format 3 entries are elementary. ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportEntryFormats (85 only) refuses a level-01 entry with format 3 clauses (a) and a format 2 entry with no immediate format 3 child (c), and #ScreenReportEntryClausePresence refuses PICTURE/COLUMN on a group (d), all COBOL2247. Nothing caps the depth: a format 2 entry subordinate to another format 2 entry (four levels) is accepted. Probes at 85: refused the witness (02 LINE 2 with no child), 01 with COLUMN PIC VALUE, a PICTURE COLUMN group over a format 3 child; accepted and printed three levels (HELLO    012), two levels (01 LINE over format 3), a level gap 02 to 05, a lone format 1 detail; under-rejected f1/f2/f2/f3 (printed "A   B"). At 2002 the four-level group compiles, as 2023 SR3 allows. kb/Work PB5426 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-06.json).

next.reason: 1985 limits a report group to 'one, two, or three hierarchic levels' (format 1 at 01, format 2 at 02-48 over format 3 elementary entries). 2023 keeps the level-1 first entry (§2023:13.15.3 SR4, §2023:13.15.4 GR1) and elementary-only PICTURE/COLUMN/SOURCE/VALUE/SUM (§2023:13.15.3 SR11) but allows 'any integer from 1 through 49' with no depth cap (§2023:13.15.3 SR3), so deeper nesting refused in 1985 is accepted. Looser; no exception condition involved.
